title: Cyber Metal
lyrics:
[instrumental intro]
(Empty reverberating pad sounds)
((Reverb)
(Pad))
(Environmental samples simulating rain and distant alarms, glitch effects)
((Like gears turning, signal interference))
(.)

[Verse 1]
Neon gasps between ruins' cracks and crevices
Data rain washes the rusty memories
Alarms flicker deep in the iris of nerves
It's the residual heartbeat the system can't observe
Gears crush the boundary of ethics so clear
In the binary womb we search for creation's code here

[Chorus]
Behind the firewall, truth starts to roar
Load up! This is the final wild spree galore

[Chorus]
Charge towards the end of the steel wasteland
Even if hydraulic veins are dry, programs go astray
Sow hope on the verge of collapse
Fight for dawn with silicon bodies and carbon souls
We're the lone boats lost in the cyber sea
We're also the electromagnetic storms through the void set free

[Verse 2]
The distorted Buddha in the rear - view mirror smiles
The fuel tank's empty, the launcher moans old guiles
The past invades the cache like a virus strike
Deleted promises return as chains to hold us tight
But I still clutch the coordinate with my fingertips
You say there'll be light at the end of nuclear dust tips

[Chorus]
The alarm of the trauma team is the background song
Tonight, be a legend or turn to scrap metal strong

[Chorus]
Charge towards the end of the steel wasteland
Even if hydraulic veins are dry, programs go astray
Sow hope on the verge of collapse
Fight for dawn with silicon bodies and carbon souls
We're the lone boats lost in the cyber sea
We're also the electromagnetic storms through the void set free

[Bridge]
Moonlight's a flowing mercury decoder
Scans my altered sorrows with its glow like a coder
If the signal breaks tomorrow
Quantum entanglement is the answer to borrow

[Outro]

(stars)

Immortal)

[End]
